.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Prototype and subsample stability analysis.

.. autoapisummary::

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: run_stability_analysis(Z, y, scoring_config, stability_config = None)

   Run prototype or subsample stability analysis.

   :param Z: Dense or sparse embedding matrix.
   :param y: Class labels.
   :param scoring_config: OverlapIndex scoring configuration.
   :param stability_config: Stability-analysis configuration.

   :returns: Stability summary dictionary, or `None` when disabled.
